items.headline: Two businesses in one site — clinic and products.
items.text: A patient looking for a procedure and a buyer of the Deflamax product line are two different visitors. I split the flows from the first screen, added online booking, and built the shop beside it.

items.headline: A site that brings people to the store door.
items.text: The business happens in the physical shop, so one page does one job: what you will find and where the store is. Hours, location and map sit right under the first screen — and the owner changes the collections from a panel.
